_: Importing a bank CSV. The reader is general — quoted fields, any column order, header matched by name — and only the NAME cleanup knows one bank's habits. The owner's file is a Wells Fargo checking export (2026-09-15, 1952 rows). See packages/core/src/csv.ts.
_delimited: Splitting CSV text into rows of fields. Rows are [input, expected rows]. A trailing newline must NOT produce a final empty row — that would import as a transaction with no date, which is the kind of thing that lands silently and is then hunted for.
_usDate: MM/DD/YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD, with no Date object anywhere near it. Rows are [input, expected or null].
_name: The short name a person reads in the list. Cosmetic by design — the bank's raw text is kept on the record either way — which is why it is allowed to be a ladder of patterns. Rows are [bank description, expected name]. Every input here is a real line from the owner's export.
